        16       patrolling Interstate 90 when he stopped a

        20       from Connecticut and that there was a

        21       passenger in the rear seat.  As it is unusual

        22       for a Connecticut taxi to be in the Albany

        23       area with an apparent fare, the driver was

        24       asked key questions to ascertain if this was a
